title: Unload the supporting hand
instruction: Park the left gripper pointing down over the green pad and leave both books flat on the blue mat without dropping them.
context: Unload two books from a supporting hand before parking that hand. A valid solution preserves both books and places them flat; no particular unloading sequence is required.
setup: Two retained LIBERO textured books scaled uniformly to approximately 79 × 65 × 17 mm, 0.10 kg each, start stacked above the left hand. They are rigid pocket-book approximations; pages do not deform. A 260 × 240 mm blue mat on a 60 mm wooden shelf receives the books, and an 80 × 80 mm green marker identifies the left-hand parking location. Exact world positions and robot start targets are in pilot.json. The table is 1100 x 1300 x 60 mm with top at world z=747.5 mm; robot bases are (0,+305,750) and (0,-305,750) mm. scene_inventory.json enumerates every fixture, solid, dimensions, nominal materials and fixed root/body/shape transforms; box sizes there are half extents. pilot.json specifies the fixed arm starts and target. setup.png is an additional native view of the unchanged reset, exposing both books. setup-policy-overview.png retains the original policy view.
scoring: Zero is latched if either book origin z < 0.7445 m, |x-0.35| > 0.60 m, |y| > 0.64 m, or downward speed > 0.35 m/s. Otherwise 0.25 per book whose horizontal center distance from (0.34,-0.12) is < 0.105 m, |z-0.8225| < 0.008 m, local-up dot world-up > 0.98 and translation speed < 0.02 m/s. Full success requires both books placed, both TCPs more than 0.08 m from each book origin, left TCP within 0.025 m of (0.5,0.2,0.763) and left-gripper local-Z dot world-Z < -0.98. Checks run at 20 Hz. Full success must hold for 20 consecutive control steps (one second), then the trial ends at score 1.0. Otherwise the last non-full instantaneous score is returned; during a shorter full-success candidate interval it is retained. Any latched violation returns zero. All remaining outcomes score zero. Origins and axes are specified in scene_inventory.json; strict inequalities exclude their boundary.
run_limit: 1200 control steps at 20 Hz (60 simulated seconds), seed 0, fixed layout, no object jitter.
reset_notes: Restore all root poses and robot starts in pilot.json and scene_inventory.json. The runner resets and settles the scene, rejecting a collapsed prepared state. Nothing is consumed. Use a fresh process and output directory per trial.
fidelity: Native Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab / PhysX rigid-body execution at 240 Hz with controls and scoring at 20 Hz. Appearance assets and nominal collision primitives are retained. Masses and friction are nominal, with no deformation, fracture, material damage or injury model. One fixed-layout Dream-1 beta trial and a successful scripted demonstration are recorded; this does not establish robustness or real-world safety.
